This ecosystem requires a combination of technologies that work together seamlessly to enable digital creators to sell their products without relying on Stripe or any other conventional payment gateway. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is one such solution that provides a comprehensive commerce infrastructure for digital creators in Pakistan and other restricted countries.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) operates on a Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments architecture. This stack is designed to provide a reliable and secure commerce infrastructure for digital creators. Cloudflare Pages hosts the website, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic. Supabase acts as the order storage solution, and NOWPayments facilitates automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This architecture works together to enable digital creators to sell their products without relying on Stripe or any other conventional payment gateway.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is built for digital creators in Pakistan and other restricted countries who need a sovereign commerce infrastructure to sell their products. This stack is designed to provide a permanent structural alternative to conventional payment gateways like Stripe. It's not just about finding an alternative to Gumroad or PayPal – it's about building a commerce ecosystem that operates independently and free from platform restrictions.

The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is composed of several components that work together to provide a reliable and secure commerce infrastructure. These components include Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component is designed to work seamlessly with the others to enable digital creators to sell their products without relying on Stripe or any other conventional payment gateway.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) today, follow these steps: First, sign up for the stack on our website. Next, deploy the stack on Cloudflare Pages and configure the backend logic with Cloudflare Workers. Then, integrate Supabase for order storage and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Finally, load your products and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability. With these steps, you can deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure that operates independently and free from platform restrictions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
